$comment: Complete operator briefs filed with --operatorTask skip prepare only after the shared prepare section validator plus Done when/Acceptance, Edge cases and we:-qualified scope checks. Cascade: standard enabled=true/maxPriority=P0 → platform build.operatorTask → tool build.operatorTask. Each leaf source is logged by policy-cascade. maxPriority is the highest allowed priority class (P0 allows all classes). Disabled filing leaves the card unstamped; disabled build admission holds operator cards for prepare even if previously stamped. Post-build steps require operatorTask: true on the card, enabled=true, an enabled policy leaf and the corresponding card field. edgeClones maps allowlisted names to workspace-relative or ~/ paths.
